findings.title: Local robots.txt blocks /suitecompare/ directory (should enumerate specific paths)
findings.description: The local public/robots.txt has Disallow: /suitecompare/ (full directory) while the live version correctly blocks only specific auth paths. When deployed, any inbound link with a trailing slash would hit the block before the 301 redirect fires.
findings.recommendation: Replace Disallow: /suitecompare/ with enumerated paths: /suitecompare/login, /suitecompare/dashboard, /suitecompare/settings. Match the live file pattern exactly.

findings.title: CSP unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval present
findings.description: These directives negate XSS protection. Does not affect SEO directly.
findings.recommendation: Implement nonce-based CSP in Next.js middleware when time permits.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: All NetSuite content technically accurate, sourced from official release notes
45 blog posts with 100% Quick Answer block coverage
Specific verifiable facts throughout: version numbers, governance unit counts, bundle IDs, deprecation dates
Strong practitioner voice in technical posts
Internal links present across all sampled posts

findings.title: No privacy policy page
findings.description: No page at /privacy or /privacy-policy. Every contact form collects personal data. Google QRG September 2025 treats privacy disclosure as a trustworthiness signal. Legal exposure for a B2B site collecting account details.
findings.recommendation: Create app/(site)/privacy/page.tsx with minimal disclosure. Link from footer. One day effort.

findings.title: netsuite-implementation-partner-vs-managed-support is ~429 words
findings.description: Service page minimum is 800 words. Companion blog post (1,468 words) on the same topic will be preferred by Google. The page designed to convert will not rank.
findings.recommendation: Add 400-500 words: decision framework section, signs-you-need-managed-support list, transition timing guidance.

findings.title: netsuite-post-go-live-checklist has zero list items
findings.description: Post is entirely prose despite being called a checklist. Users arriving expecting an operational checklist will bounce immediately. Intent mismatch is a conversion barrier and bounce driver.
findings.recommendation: Add bulleted checklist under each H2. Keep prose as explanation — additive change only.

findings.title: 12 blog/resource pairs have high duplicate content risk
findings.description: Semantic overlap is high between pairs. Google cannot determine canonical preference without explicit signals. Affects: rest-batch-sequential, user-event-vs-client-script, suiteql-bound-parameters, payment-adjustments, payment-runs, passkey-second-factor, suitetax-term-discounts, currency-context-custom-fields, sales-order-fulfillment-list, bank-reconciliation, project-health-indicators, advanced-record-customization.
findings.recommendation: For 6 pairs where blog post is under 1,200 words: 301-redirect resource to blog post. For remaining 6: differentiate — resource becomes pure code reference, blog stays narrative.

findings.title: 30 resources have no date fields
findings.description: All 30 files in content/resources/*.md have no machine-readable publication date. Zero freshness signal on 30 indexed pages.
findings.recommendation: Add publishedAt frontmatter to each resource file. Verify resource layout renders it in ArticleJsonLd datePublished.

findings.title: Credentials mentioned on only 3 of 22 service pages and zero blog posts
findings.description: Oracle NetSuite SuiteCloud Developer II and Administrator Professional certifications appear only on consulting-services, suitescript-development, and hire-netsuite-developer.
findings.recommendation: Add one-line credential reference to remaining service pages and to the blog post callout box.

findings.title: netsuite-saved-search-examples: 322 impressions, 0% CTR
findings.description: At position 17 with zero clicks. Title has no count. Meta description is not benefit-led. Listicle titles without a number at positions 10-25 consistently underperform.
findings.recommendation: Update H1 and title to '10 NetSuite Saved Search Examples (Finance, Operations, Admin)'. Rewrite meta description to lead with number and benefit. Add updated field.

findings.title: netsuite-saved-search-tips: 443 impressions, 0.23% CTR
findings.description: High impressions indicate strong query match but the SERP presentation is failing to convert. Meta description not specific enough at positions 25-35.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite meta description with specific tip examples ('5 saved search tips including cross-join columns, conditional formatting, and role-based defaults'). Add updated field.

findings.title: hire-netsuite-developer at position 61 due to internal link deficit
findings.description: Page content is strong (~1,363 words, certifications, ServiceJsonLd). Position 61 reflects internal link equity deficit — only one service page links to it.
findings.recommendation: Add /hire-netsuite-developer link to every SuiteScript, Map/Reduce, User Event, and SuiteQL blog post alongside the existing /netsuite-suitescript-development CTA.

findings.title: VideoObjectJsonLd missing duration field
findings.description: Google VideoObject requires duration in ISO 8601 format. The component lacks this field. All 30 call sites are missing it. Blocks rich result eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Add duration?: string to VideoObjectJsonLd interface in components/seo/JsonLd.tsx. Update all 30 call sites with ISO 8601 duration of video IQvWN_yZ24A.

findings.title: ArticleJsonLd missing from /resources/[slug] and /case-studies/[slug]
findings.description: 30 resources and all case studies are indexed content with no structured data schema beyond BreadcrumbList.
findings.recommendation: Add ArticleJsonLd to both layout templates. Single template change covers 30+ pages.

findings.title: netsuite-oracle-support-vs-third-party uses ServiceJsonLd (should be ArticleJsonLd)
findings.description: Comparison article using service page schema. Misrepresents content type.
findings.recommendation: Replace ServiceJsonLd with ArticleJsonLd using same pattern as netsuite-freelancer-vs-consulting-firm.tsx.

findings.title: ServiceJsonLd, BlogPostingJsonLd, ArticleJsonLd missing @id anchors
findings.description: Without @id, Google cannot build entity relationships across pages in the Knowledge Graph.
findings.recommendation: Add @id to each: ServiceJsonLd -> url#service, BlogPostingJsonLd -> SITE_URL/blog/slug#article, ArticleJsonLd -> url#article.

findings.title: OrganizationJsonLd missing foundingDate
findings.description: LLMs use founding date to assess business stability. Without it, the entity is harder to anchor in time.
findings.recommendation: Add foundingDate to OrganizationJsonLd data object in components/seo/JsonLd.tsx.

findings.title: Only 38% of posts use question-format H2 headings (17 of 45)
findings.description: 28 posts use statement headings. AI systems match section headings against user query strings. Question headings are directly extractable as question-answer pairs.
findings.recommendation: Start with highest-traffic posts: Map/Reduce guide, NLAuth retirement, post-go-live checklist. Then release-note posts.

findings.title: YouTube URL missing from llms.txt; 10 August posts missing from index
findings.description: YouTube is the strongest AI citation correlation signal (0.737). Channel is in OrganizationJsonLd sameAs but not in llms.txt contact section.
findings.recommendation: Add '- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SuitePacific' to llms.txt contact section. Add 10 August 2026 posts to blog index.

findings.title: Single video ID across all 30 VideoObject pages
findings.description: All 30 VideoObjectJsonLd deployments reference the same video ID. From GEO perspective this is one YouTube entity, not 30.
findings.recommendation: Create a second video (even a 2-minute screen recording) to establish a second independent YouTube brand mention.

findings.title: No Wikipedia or Wikidata entity
findings.description: Wikipedia presence is the highest-impact missing signal for ChatGPT. Without it, ChatGPT treats SuitePacific as an arbitrary firm rather than an established entity.
findings.recommendation: Create Wikidata entry for SuitePacific LLC (achievable now). Add URL to OrganizationJsonLd sameAs. Wikipedia article requires demonstrated notability — longer-term goal.

findings.title: nlauth-tba Quick Answer is 126 words (optimal floor is 134)
findings.description: Only Quick Answer block identified as below optimal floor.
findings.recommendation: Add one sentence (~8 words): 'If you are unsure which integrations use NLAuth, run a search in Setup under Integration Records and filter by authentication type.'
